name: DFE Services
description: Every scalo service side by side: what it processed, how hard it is working, and what it is waiting on.

config.name: Services reporting
config.sqlTemplate:
-- The Rust chassis registers `info` as a gauge and scalo-py as a counter, so
-- an inventory that reads one table only ever sees half the fleet.
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       any(version) AS "Version",
       count(DISTINCT pod) AS "Pods",
       max(seen) AS "Last seen",
       toUInt64(dateDiff('second', max(seen), now())) AS "Seconds ago"
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, Attributes['version'] AS version,
         ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, TimeUnix AS seen
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'info' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ServiceName, Attributes['version'] AS version,
         ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, TimeUnix AS seen
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'info' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
)
GROUP BY ServiceName
ORDER BY ServiceName

config.name: Records received per second
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       ServiceName AS "Service",
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Records/second"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'records_received_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Records delivered per second
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       ServiceName AS "Service",
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Records/second"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'records_delivered_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Records lost to DLQ, filters and errors
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, '_total', '')) AS "Service and outcome",
       max(Value) - min(Value) AS "Records"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName IN ('records_dlq_total', 'records_filtered_total', 'records_error_total', 'dlq_pushed_total')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, MetricName
HAVING "Records" > 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Received against delivered, by service
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       toUInt64(sumIf(span, MetricName = 'records_received_total')) AS "Received",
       toUInt64(sumIf(span, MetricName = 'records_processed_total')) AS "Processed",
       toUInt64(sumIf(span, MetricName = 'records_delivered_total')) AS "Delivered",
       toUInt64(sumIf(span, MetricName IN ('records_dlq_total', 'dlq_pushed_total'))) AS "To DLQ"
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, MetricName, max(Value) - min(Value) AS span
  FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName IN ('records_received_total', 'records_processed_total', 'records_delivered_total', 'records_dlq_total', 'dlq_pushed_total')
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ServiceName, MetricName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']
)
GROUP BY ServiceName
ORDER BY "Received" DESC

config.name: Worker pool saturation
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       ServiceName AS "Service",
       avg(Value) AS "Saturation"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'worker_pool_saturation' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Worker threads: active against the scaler's target
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'worker_pool_', '')) AS "Series",
       avg(Value) AS "Threads"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('worker_pool_active_threads', 'worker_pool_target_threads', 'worker_pool_max_threads')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: What the scaler is reacting to
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', replaceOne(replaceOne(MetricName, 'worker_pool_', ''), '_utilisation', '')) AS "Series",
       avg(Value) AS "Utilisation"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('worker_pool_cpu_utilisation', 'worker_pool_memory_utilisation', 'worker_pool_memory_psi_some')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Pool scaling events
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS "Service and direction",
       max(Value) - min(Value) AS "Events"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'worker_pool_scale_events_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, Attributes['direction']
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Container memory against its limit
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, if(MetricName = 'container_memory_limit_bytes', ' limit', ' used')) AS "Series",
       avg(Value) AS "Bytes"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('container_memory_usage_bytes', 'container_memory_limit_bytes')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Process CPU cores used
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       ServiceName AS "Service",
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Cores"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'process_cpu_seconds_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Open file descriptors
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       ServiceName AS "Service",
       max(Value) AS "Descriptors"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'process_open_fds' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Process uptime
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod",
       toDateTime(toUInt64(max(Value))) AS "Started",
       toUInt64(now() - max(Value)) AS "Uptime seconds",
       formatReadableTimeDelta(toUInt64(now() - max(Value))) AS "Uptime"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'process_start_time_seconds' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']
ORDER BY ServiceName

config.name: Consumer lag by topic and partition
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', Attributes['topic'], '/', Attributes['partition']) AS "Partition",
       max(Value) AS "Lag"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'rdkafka_topic_partition_consumer_lag' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, Attributes['topic'], Attributes['partition']
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Client queue depth
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'rdkafka_', '')) AS "Series",
       max(Value) AS "Messages"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('rdkafka_global_msg_cnt', 'rdkafka_broker_outbuf_cnt', 'rdkafka_broker_waitresp_cnt')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Broker round-trip time
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' ', Attributes['broker']) AS "Client and broker",
       avg(Value) AS "RTT"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'rdkafka_broker_rtt_avg_seconds' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName, Attributes['broker']
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Offsets committed and rebalances
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       Attributes['topic'] AS "Topic",
       Attributes['partition'] AS "Partition",
       toUInt64(max(Value)) AS "Committed offset",
       toUInt64(max(Value) - min(Value)) AS "Advanced by"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'rdkafka_topic_partition_committed_offset' AND Value > 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ServiceName, Attributes['topic'], Attributes['partition']
ORDER BY "Service", "Topic", "Partition"

config.name: Rows into ClickHouse
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Rows/second"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'rows_inserted_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Buffer waiting to flush
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       replaceOne(MetricName, 'buffer_', '') AS "Series",
       avg(Value) AS "Buffered"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('buffer_rows', 'buffer_tables', 'clickhouse_inserter_inflight')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Insert batches and bytes
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       replaceOne(MetricName, '_total', '') AS "Series",
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Per second"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName IN ('batches_flushed_total', 'insert_transactions_total', 'kafka_offsets_committed_total')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Messages by destination table
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT Attributes['table'] AS "Table",
       toUInt64(max(Value) - min(Value)) AS "Messages"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'loader_messages_by_table_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY Attributes['table']
ORDER BY "Messages" DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Requests by transport
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(Attributes['transport'], if(MetricName = 'receiver_requests_success_total', ' ok', ' all')) AS "Series",
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Requests/second"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName IN ('receiver_requests_total', 'receiver_requests_success_total')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, Attributes['transport'], MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Bytes in and out
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       if(MetricName = 'receiver_kafka_bytes_sent_total', 'to Kafka', 'from clients') AS "Direction",
       (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s AS "Bytes/second"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName IN ('receiver_bytes_received_total', 'receiver_kafka_bytes_sent_total')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, MetricName
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Dead letter queue
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       concat(ServiceName, ' pending') AS "Series",
       max(Value) AS "Records"
FROM dfe.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'dlq_pending' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, ServiceName
ORDER BY ts
